svg.title: Their exponential factors agree everywhere. Their cutofffactors need not agree globally, but both equal one near every cone point p: use the intersection of the unit ball about p and the inverse image of the unit ball about r∨p. Consequently their difference has closed support disjoint from the cone and is annihilated by c Wv. Fourier transformation of boundary covariance, followed by this lens comparison, gives F(ρ(r)vi)i(rZ) = Fv(Z). (TI2)
